study type: Descriptive study with comparative analysis (case report with controls)
outcome: Hormone levels (gonadotropins, sex hormone-binding globulin, total and free T, androstenedione, dehydroepiandrosterone sulfate, estrone, estradiol)
cohort: The study included an index woman with NIH-defined PCOS and severely reduced AMH, compared to 13 age- and BMI-matched women with PCOS and detectable AMH, and 20 normoandrogenic ovulatory control women (all aged 19-35 years with BMI 19-25 kg/m2).
finding: A homozygous Ala515Val AMH variant (rs10417628) was identified in the index woman with PCOS, severely impairing serum AMH immunoactivity without affecting its bioactivity or her PCOS phenotypic expression.
cross-section timing: At the time of evaluation for each participant (ages 19-35 years)
